content: Plan: (1) rustfmt.toml — explicit fmt config (edition 2024, line width, import grouping); (2) .cargo/deny.toml — cargo-deny config (license allowlist, advisories, duplicate crate policy); (3) .cargo/mutants.toml — cargo-mutants config (timeout, exclude patterns for non-core modules); (4) Cargo.toml — add [lints] table with clippy lint groups at deny level; (5) Verify: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test all pass from scaffold state.
